issue.title: redis_hset does not escape the parameters correctly

failure.body:
When this functions
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/3f7ce574eec619b1bba0c10d9b07ff8a6cf705aa/tests/common/helpers/sonic_db.py#L263

is called with an argument starting with "-" it interprets it as a CLI option
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/platform_tests/daemon/test_thermalctld.py#L351

```
sonic-db-cli STATE_DB HSET 'TEMPERATURE_INFO|test_critical_thermal_monitor' temperature 120.0 critical_high_threshold 80.0 high_threshold 70.0 low_threshold '-10.0' warning False timestamp 2099-01-01T00:00:00
Command Line Error: Unknown argument:-10.0
usage: sonic-db-cli [-h] [-s] [-n NAMESPACE] db_or_op [cmd [cmd ...]]

SONiC DB CLI:

```

Need to properly escape it with "--":
```
sonic-db-cli STATE_DB -- HSET ........
```

resolution.title: Added "--" to sonic-db-cli HSET command.
